footnote_text: Sixth Street Specialty Lending Advisers, LLC ("Advisers") directly holds 2,714,226 shares of common stock, $0.01 par value per share (the "Common Stock") of Sixth Street Specialty Lending, Inc. (the "Issuer"), including shares of Common Stock indirectly beneficially owned by the Reporting Person (through his limited partnership interest in TSL Equity Partners, L.P. ("TSL"), which is a member of Sixth Street Specialty Lending Advisers Holdings, LLC, which in turn is a member of Advisers). || This transaction reflects the acquisition by a limited liability company ("LLC") of limited partnership interests in TSL from an existing limited partner. The number of shares of Issuer Common Stock reported as acquired reflects the Reporting Person's indirect beneficial ownership in the shares acquired through such limited partnership interest in TSL. In connection with the acquisition by the LLC, the LLC paid the transferors an aggregate of $109,367.87. No shares were purchased or sold by Advisers in connection with this transaction. || Shares are held directly by Sixth Street Specialty Lending Advisers, LLC ("Adviser"). Adviser is managed by Sixth Street Specialty Lending Advisers Holdings, LLC, the sole member of Adviser. Sixth Street Specialty Lending Advisers Holdings, LLC is managed by TSSP Holdco Management, LLC, which is managed by a board of directors, which is currently comprised of Reporting Person. Reporting Person is the CEO of TSSP Holdco Management, LLC.
